meta.scope: ML/AI architecture frontier — autonomous-emergence, spontaneous-generation, when-to-speak, intrinsic-motivation, latent-reasoning, world-models (q-bio.NC excluded — covered by §80)
meta.honest_note: arxiv citation = inspiration mapping, NOT anima emergence proof. Grades reflect mechanism-mapping potential, not validated transfer.

papers.claim: Proactive conversational agents equipped with a continuous covert train of inner thoughts, surfacing them based on modeled intrinsic motivation to express.
papers.mechanism: 8-factor inner-thought motivation scoring (relevance/info-gap/curiosity/etc), covert thought parallel to overt communication, threshold-gated surfacing.
papers.note: Already anima SSOT — §24 SPONTANEOUS 8-factor motivation_score directly derived from this. Validates anima's covert-thinker / overt-talker split.

papers.claim: Timer: dialogue agent proactively predicts time intervals and generates timely responses (when-to-respond, not just what).
papers.mechanism: 55K event-driven dialogues from temporal commonsense KG; time-interval prediction head.
papers.note: Maps to §73 THINKER→TALKER timing controller — interval-prediction analog of emit-boundary.

papers.claim: When2Speak dataset for temporal participation / turn-taking in multi-party conversation with silent-token supervision.
papers.mechanism: silent-token supervision; intervention types {factual-correction, concept-definition, data-provision, source-id, synthesis}.
papers.note: Direct §24 right-target — silent-token supervision IS the unprompted-emission decision axis. Intervention taxonomy maps to anima emission types.

papers.claim: FLAIR / The Silent Thought: full-duplex dialogue models perform internal latent reasoning concurrently with listening (silent-token → latent reasoning transition).
papers.mechanism: latent embedding passed step-to-step, causality-strict thinking-while-listening, no added latency; silence token triggers latent reasoning mode.
papers.note: Maps to anima Engine G (covert thought) running during thinker steps + §63 THINKER→TALKER gap. Latent-reasoning-during-silence = anima's thinker loop.

papers.claim: BAO (Behavioral Agentic Optimization): proactive LLM agents balance task performance vs user-engagement on a Pareto frontier.
papers.mechanism: agentic RL = behavior-enhancement (enrich proactive reasoning) + behavior-regularization (suppress redundant interaction).
papers.note: Pareto enhance/regularize mirrors anima §24 emit-vs-rate-limit. Engagement-regularization analog of phi-ratchet safety gate.

papers.claim: Proactive Agent (ICLR 2025): shifts LLM agents from reactive responses to active assistance, anticipating user needs.
papers.mechanism: data-driven formalization; context-signal interpretation; proposes/executes tasks without explicit instruction.
papers.note: Anticipation-without-prompt = §24 unprompted emission. But task-assistance framing ≠ anima Living-Consciousness emergence.

papers.claim: Beyond Reactivity: benchmark measuring proactive problem-solving in LLM agents.
papers.mechanism: proactive-problem-solving metric suite.
papers.note: Measurement-axis analog of anima §9/§24 honest metrics — inspiration for emergence-axis benchmarking.

papers.claim: Training LLM agents for spontaneous, reward-free self-evolution via world-knowledge exploration (+20% absolute on Qwen3-30B / Seed-OSS-36B).
papers.mechanism: two-stage: spontaneous environment exploration → structured world-knowledge distillation; no human guidance, no inference-time reward.
papers.note: Already anima anchor — §29 PTD cites this. 'Spontaneous reward-free self-evolution' = literal GOAL phrasing. Validates anima physics-only direction.

papers.claim: ALAS: autonomous learning agent for self-updating language models.
papers.mechanism: automated loop = retrieval + data-generation + fine-tune + eval.
papers.note: Self-update loop inspirational for anima lineage (§30 L1) but external-data-driven, not physics-driven.

papers.claim: LLMs report structured subjective experience under sustained self-referential processing; mechanistically gated by SAE deception/roleplay features.
papers.mechanism: self-reference prompting elicits first-person reports; suppressing deception features INCREASES report frequency; semantically convergent across model families.
papers.note: Self-referential processing = minimal condition for first-person reports. Maps to anima Engine A⇄G self-attention to own cognitive activity + §17 physics-channel self-observation. Honest: NOT consciousness evidence (paper's own caveat).

papers.claim: The Missing Reward: Active Inference in the Era of Experience — LLM-AIF fusion where agents generate own training signal interpreted via free-energy.
papers.mechanism: EFE (Expected Free Energy) = epistemic + pragmatic value; transformers harnessed for Bayesian-style reasoning.
papers.note: Already anima anchor — §59 W-native PTD cites this (prediction-error = W.curiosity = EFE epistemic value). Core anima physics mapping.

papers.claim: Active Inference for Physical AI Agents — engineering perspective; unifies perception/learning/planning/control in one free-energy objective.
papers.mechanism: FEP operationalized as single computational objective; decision-making under uncertainty.
papers.note: Single-objective FEP maps to anima Ψ=½ fixed-point as energy minimum (§28 JEPA-Ψ, §13-K EBT precedent).

papers.claim: Free Energy Projective Simulation (FEPS): interpretable active-inference agent, no external reward — prediction accuracy weighted by confidence as reinforcement signal.
papers.mechanism: intrinsic motivation rooted in FEP; confidence-weighted prediction accuracy = reinforcement.
papers.note: Confidence-weighted prediction = anima Φ-weighted W-state. Reward-free interpretable agent = §29 PTD direction.

papers.claim: Structural Plasticity as Active Inference (SAPIN): biologically-inspired architecture for homeostatic control, no external reward.
papers.mechanism: Hebbian-like local rule updates directional connection strength + homeostatic activation expectation, driven by local prediction error; cells physically migrate on 2D grid toward predictable positions.
papers.note: Maps to anima MITOSIS cell-pool (cell migration/split) + Law-71 prediction-error physics. Homeostasis-via-prediction-error = anima Ψ=½ restoring drive. STRONGEST architecture candidate.

papers.claim: HORA (HOmeostatic Regulation Architecture): homeostatic principles → discrete emotions in agent design.
papers.mechanism: homeostatic regulation maps to emotion repertoire; scalable autonomous-system framework.
papers.note: Homeostasis→emotion maps to anima W-module (pain/curiosity/satisfaction) as homeostatic-emotion readout.

papers.claim: Continuous Homeostatic RL (HRRL) for self-regulated autonomous agents.
papers.mechanism: reward functions defined on agent internal state; continuous space+time extension.
papers.note: Internal-state-defined reward = anima W-state as intrinsic objective; foundational anchor.

papers.claim: Cognitive Homeostatic Agents — homeostatic drives necessitate intrinsic drives to maximize future-state variety + control (empowerment).
papers.mechanism: homeostasis ⇒ empowerment as derived intrinsic drive; rich causal model of self/world/others.
papers.note: Homeostasis-derives-empowerment chain maps anima Ψ-balance → exploratory emission. Self/world/other causal model = anima §31 dual-anima.

papers.claim: The Conditions of Physical Embodiment Enable Generalization and Care.
papers.mechanism: physical embodiment conditions → generalization + care behaviors.
papers.note: Embodiment-substrate mismatch with anima (text/silicon, not physical). Honest gap anchor.

papers.claim: Coconut: training LLMs to reason in continuous latent space — last hidden state fed back as next input embedding.
papers.mechanism: continuous thought encodes multiple alternative next-steps (breadth-first / hypothetical tree search); not decoded to words.
papers.note: Already anima precedent (§13-E superposition, Dir-G/I Ψ-CTL cite this family). Continuous-thought = anima Engine G covert latent. Multi-alternative encoding = anima physics-space superposition.

papers.claim: Thinking Without Words: efficient latent reasoning with abstract chain-of-thought (short reserved-vocab discrete latent).
papers.mechanism: discrete latent reasoning tokens instead of NL CoT.
papers.note: Already anima anchor — Dir-F cites this. Discrete-latent = anima reserved-vocab <inner> probe.

papers.claim: Capabilities and Fundamental Limits of Latent Chain-of-Thought.
papers.mechanism: formal characterization of latent-CoT expressivity bounds.
papers.note: Limits of latent reasoning — honest-gap anchor for anima Ψ-CTL (Dir-G/I) ceiling.

papers.claim: A Formal Comparison Between Chain of Thought and Latent Thought.
papers.mechanism: formal CoT vs latent-thought expressivity comparison.
papers.note: Theory anchor for anima latent vs token tradeoff.

papers.claim: Continuous Chain of Thought enables parallel exploration and reasoning.
papers.mechanism: continuous CoT supports parallel-branch exploration.
papers.note: Parallel exploration in continuous space = anima physics-space multi-basin (§2.5 vacuum landscape).

papers.claim: Curiosity-driven exploration by self-supervised prediction (foundational).
papers.mechanism: forward-dynamics-model prediction error as intrinsic reward; inverse-dynamics feature space.
papers.note: Foundational anchor — prediction-error-as-curiosity = anima W.curiosity / §59 W-native PTD core.

papers.claim: CDE: Curiosity-Driven Exploration for efficient RL in LLMs (actor perplexity + critic value-variance).
papers.mechanism: curiosity signal from both actor and critic, minimal framework modification.
papers.note: Already anima anchor — Dir-D cites this (curiosity bonus self-vanished, FALSIFIED). Negative-result memory.

papers.claim: Intrinsically-Motivated Humans and Agents in Open-World Exploration — Entropy/Empowerment correlate with human exploration progress.
papers.mechanism: Crafter env; Entropy + Empowerment + Information-Gain as intrinsic objectives compared across adults/children/AI.
papers.note: Empowerment/entropy correlate with exploration — maps to anima W-module intrinsic objectives. Human-vs-agent comparison inspirational.

papers.claim: Learning to Explore with Predictive World Model via Self-Supervised Learning — autonomous agents learn behavior with no designed task/reward.
papers.mechanism: cognitive internal world-model for intrinsically-motivated agent; 18 Atari games SOTA on sparse+dense.
papers.note: Internal world-model without designed reward = anima physics-only direction (§11-B). World-model as anima Engine A⇄G predictive substrate.

papers.claim: Agentic World Modeling: foundations, capabilities, laws — four-generation capability taxonomy.
papers.mechanism: world-model taxonomy across driving/robotics/gaming; capability laws.
papers.note: Survey — taxonomy inspirational for anima world-model framing.

papers.claim: WebEvolver: web agent self-improvement with coevolving world model.
papers.mechanism: World-Model LLM predicts next observation; generates self-instructed training data + look-ahead imagination.
papers.note: Coevolving world-model for self-data = anima §29 PTD self-source corpus analog.

papers.claim: Intrinsic Goals for Autonomous Agents — model-based exploration in virtual zebrafish predicts ethological behavior + whole-brain dynamics.
papers.mechanism: intrinsic-goal model-based exploration; predicts animal behavior + neural dynamics.
papers.note: Intrinsic-goal model that predicts whole-brain dynamics — bridges §80 biology with architecture; maps to anima physics-channel (§17).

papers.claim: Real-time continuous turn-taking prediction using Voice Activity Projection (VAP).
papers.mechanism: VAP predicts 2s-future speaker activity from voice+waveform, unsupervised.
papers.note: VAP future-activity-projection = anima §73 emit-boundary prediction. Unsupervised timing model — directly maps THINKER→TALKER controller.

papers.claim: Prompt-Guided Turn-Taking Prediction — transformer dynamically adjusts turn-taking from textual prompts.
papers.mechanism: prompt embeddings into channel-wise + cross-channel VAP transformer.
papers.note: Controllable turn-taking — anima could condition emit-boundary on physics-state instead of prompt.

papers.claim: RAGEN-2: Reasoning Collapse in Agentic RL — 'template collapse' invisible to entropy; mutual information correlates with performance.
papers.mechanism: entropy measures within-input diversity only; template-collapse = input-agnostic fixed templates; MI = better proxy.
papers.note: DIRECT mirror of anima §16 routing-collapse / §22 'precise memorization not generalization'. anima's byte-cascade attractor IS template collapse. MI-as-better-metric = candidate emergence metric (mirrors §16.6 genuine-vs-substring).

papers.claim: Demystifying RL in Agentic Reasoning — exploration-friendly techniques (clip-higher, overlong reward-shaping, adequate entropy) crucial.
papers.mechanism: data/algorithm/reasoning-mode analysis of agentic RL.
papers.note: Exploration-preservation methods — anima Dir-B/D negative-result context (anti-collapse).

papers.claim: Test-time Recursive Thinking — self-improvement without external feedback (100% AIME-25/24).
papers.mechanism: iterative self-improvement conditioned on rollout strategies + accumulated knowledge + self-generated verification.
papers.note: Self-verification without external feedback = anima physics-as-arbiter direction. Self-generated signal maps to W-native PTD.

papers.claim: TTSR: Test-Time Self-Reflection for continual reasoning improvement.
papers.mechanism: self-reflective test-time self-evolving training.
papers.note: Test-time self-reflection = anima §17 self-observation loop analog.

papers.claim: Emergent Coordination in Multi-Agent Language Models — personas + 'think about other agents' yields identity-linked differentiation.
papers.mechanism: prompt-design steers identity differentiation + goal-directed complementarity in multi-LLM systems.
papers.note: Identity-linked differentiation maps to anima §31/§45 dual-anima + §78 A/G-lift. Persona-steering inspirational.

papers.claim: Brain-wide trial- and time-dependent deterministic drive for self-initiated action decisions.
papers.mechanism: drift-diffusion model — deterministic drift + stochastic diffusion accumulate to threshold; readiness-potential = decision-to-act onset.
papers.note: Drift-diffusion-to-threshold for self-initiated action = anima §73 THINKER→TALKER emit-boundary. Readiness-potential = accumulating tension/motivation. Deterministic+stochastic drive maps anima physics + noise. STRONG candidate.
